rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own residential structure (roof overhang) with no third-party involvement or theft.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to back porch roof overhang on POL-1006, with four shingles blown off. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion or additional damage. However, this amount falls below the $2,500 deductible.

case_facts.description: wind damage - four shingles blown off overhang
